newsitem.title: CHINA: Heilongjiang Power to list new B shares.
newsitem.headline: Heilongjiang Power to list new B shares.

text.p: Heilongjiang Electric Power Co's 80 million new foreign currency B shares will be listed on the Shanghai stock exchange on Wednesday, a company statement said on Tuesday.

The shares were issued on Wednesday last week in a private placement to Shenyin & Wanguo Securities, China's top brokerage, and ING Barings at a price of $0.838 per share, the statement, published in the Shanghai Securities News, said.
The power company's listed B shares closed at $0.87 per share on Monday.

The company raised a total of $64.9 million from the issue and proceeds will be used to buy and operate a set of electric power generators in the Mudanjiang area of Heilongjiang Province in China's far northeast, the statement said.
After the issue, Heilongjiang Power's share capital has been increased by 20.42 percent, with a total of 391.8044 million outstanding shares, the statement said.
The state owns 171.8044 million shares, B shares account for 180 million shares and domestic A shares 40 million shares, the statement said.
